Fiscal Year Totals (**)                4,647            1,319             6,312              5,602           10,222

(A) APDs received counts APDs received by the BLM and the APD Fee has been paid during the reporting period.

(B) APDs Pending includes cumulative APDs received without a final disposition. This includes the steps in the process
where the BLM is determining completeness of the application, or the Operator is addressing deficiencies such as,
Wildlife or Cultural Clearances, or the application is impacted by ongoing leasing litigation, and APDs awaiting final
decision.

(C) APDs Processed include APDs that are approved (column D), denied, returned, withdrawn, or cancelled.
(*) AAPDs are APDs that have been approved and are available to drill. For APDs approved prior to June 22, 2024,
these AAPDs are either in their original two-year term or have been granted an extension beyond the first two years, but
not to exceed a total of four years. For APDs approved between June 22, 2024, and July 3, 2025, these AAPDs are in
their three-year term. For APDs approved after July 4, 2025, these APDs are in their four-year term. This AAPD number
is accurate on the date that the report is generated, which is distinct from the data on APD status for the month. Once an
APD is drilled, expired, or withdrawn, it is removed from the Approved and Available (AAPDs) numbers.
(**) Fiscal Year Totals Cover 10/1/2025 to 9/30/2026
Individual State Office data includes APD activity for both Federal and Tribal lands
Data current as of 10/1/2026
The data in this report is accurate on the date it is pulled. Changes to previously reported numbers may result from
ongoing data quality control reviews.

awaiting final decision.

(C) APDs Processed include APDs that are approved (column D), denied, returned, withdrawn, or cancelled.
(*) AAPDs are APDs that have been approved and are available to drill. For APDs approved prior to June 22, 2024,
these AAPDs are either in their original two-year term or have been granted an extension beyond the first two years,
but not to exceed a total of four years. For APDs approved between June 22, 2024, and July 3, 2025, these AAPDs
are in their three-year term. For APDs approved after July 4, 2025, these APDs are in their four-year term. This
AAPD number is accurate on the date that the report is generated, which is distinct from the data on APD status for
the month. Once an APD is drilled, expired, or withdrawn, it is removed from the Approved and Available (AAPDs)
numbers.
